The test image shows a soybean leaf with small scattered circular/irregular spots that have yellow halos surrounding dark brown/reddish-brown centers. Some lesions have purplish-red margins. This is a leaf disease.

Leaf candidates from part index: Anthracnose, Bacterial_Blight, Bacterial_Pustule, Bean_Pod_Mottle_virus, Brown_Stem_Rot, Cercospora, Downy_mildew, Frogeye_leaf_spot, Phyllosticta_leaf_spot, Powdery_Mildew, Septoria_brown_spot, Soybean_Cyst_Nematode, Soybean_Vein_necrosis_virus, Soybean_rust, Sudden_death_syndrome.

Top suspects: Frogeye_leaf_spot (circular gray lesions with reddish-brown borders and yellow halos), Bacterial_Blight (yellow-green halos), Bacterial_Pustule, Septoria_brown_spot.

Let me view reference images one at a time, starting with Frogeye_leaf_spot.
Frogeye shows small circular spots with reddish-brown margins, some fallen out. Somewhat similar but the test image has more prominent yellow halos. Let me check Bacterial_Blight.
This Bacterial_Blight reference shows small lesions with distinct yellow halos around dark necrotic centers - very similar to the test image! Let me check Bacterial_Pustule next.
This is too close-up and doesn't match. Let me check Septoria_brown_spot.
Septoria shows heavy yellowing with dense dark blotches - doesn't match. Bacterial_Blight remains top candidate. Let me check Soybean_rust.
Rust shows tiny dense reddish-brown dots - doesn't match (test has larger spots with yellow halos). Let me check Soybean_Vein_necrosis_virus.
SVNV shows large irregular spots - doesn't match. Continuing through leaf classes. Checking Cercospora.
Cercospora shows diffuse bronze/reddish-brown discoloration - not a match. Checking Downy_mildew.
Downy mildew shows pale yellow spots without dark centers - not a match. Checking Phyllosticta_leaf_spot.
Phyllosticta shows large marginal brown lesions - not a match. Checking Powdery_Mildew.
White powdery coating - not a match. Checking Brown_Stem_Rot leaf.
BSR shows interveinal necrosis pattern - not a match. Checking Sudden_death_syndrome.
SDS shows large interveinal blotches - not a match. Checking Bean_Pod_Mottle_virus.
BPMV shows green/yellow mottling - not a match. Checking Anthracnose leaf.
Anthracnose shows small reddish spots but no yellow halos. Checking Soybean_Cyst_Nematode leaf.
SCN shows general plant yellowing - not a match. For my 16th view, confirming Bacterial_Blight with another reference.

All 16 views complete. Summary of findings:

- **Bacterial_Blight** (Dise_56): Closest match - small lesions with distinct yellow halos around dark necrotic centers, scattered on green leaf
- **Frogeye_leaf_spot**: Small circular spots with reddish-brown margins but no prominent yellow halos
- All others: Clearly different patterns (diffuse bronze, large blotches, powdery coating, mottling, interveinal necrosis)

The test image shows scattered small spots with pronounced yellow/lime-green halos surrounding dark brown-reddish centers on a green leaf. This matches Bacterial_Blight most closely - both visually (Dise_56 reference) and per description ("yellowish-green halos around lesions"). The lesions appear somewhat circular but could be angular depending on vein positioning. The KB notes angular/vein-limited lesions are most common, and the pattern strongly aligns with the Bacterial_Blight reference image.
